data.long_description:
Experience refined villa living in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club - The Residences, where generous space, everyday comfort, and a peaceful setting come together in this well-appointed 5-bedroom residence spanning 6,411.24 sq. ft.

The villa features a well-considered layout designed to support both privacy and communal living. Expansive interiors create a seamless flow between living and dining areas, while large windows throughout the home enhance natural light and contribute to a bright, airy ambiance. Each of the five bedrooms is generously proportioned, complemented by six bathrooms finished with a balance of practicality and style.

Positioned within a serene, low-density polo community, the home benefits from landscaped surroundings and open green views, offering a calm residential environment while remaining well connected to key destinations across Dubai.

Property Features:

5 well-proportioned bedrooms with built-in storage
6 bathrooms with modern fittings and finishes
Spacious open-plan living and dining areas
Large windows enhancing light and openness
Functional kitchen with ample storage and workspace
Private outdoor space suitable for relaxation or entertaining
Covered parking facilities

Community Features:

Secure gated polo-themed community
Extensive landscaped green areas
Dedicated walking and cycling paths
Access to leisure and lifestyle amenities
Family-oriented and peaceful environment

This residence presents a strong opportunity for end-users seeking a spacious villa within a distinctive and established Dubai community.
